title: NFIRS incidents by incident type series
source: ohpah-research Supabase, table nfirs_basicincident, project casmwfxrxlysqizxahcw

scope.note: FLORIDA ONLY. A count of distinct states over the whole table returns 1. Do not describe this as a national record.

row_accounting.note: NOTHING is excluded from the total. 11 rows carry a non numeric inc_type and so fall out of the percentage denominator only. An earlier draft claimed 2,379 exclusions; that figure came from pg_stat_user_tables.n_live_tup, which is an ESTIMATE and not a count. Never derive a statistic from n_live_tup.

query: select left(inc_type,1) as series, count(*) from nfirs_basicincident where inc_type ~ '^[0-9]' group by 1 order by 1

rejected_finding.claim_tested: NFIRS firefighter injury reporting is inaccurate
rejected_finding.conclusion: 98.6 percent agreement between the basic module injury counts and the filed casualty modules. This is the OPPOSITE of an under reporting story. Do not use it as one.
